Additional One changes to minizip-ng 4.1.2 (2026-10-10)

mz_zip.c, mz_zip_entry_read_close:
- Close the decryption filter explicitly and propagate its status. The
  compression filter's close does not close the base filter; WinZip AES
  authentication is checked by the decryption filter's close routine.
- Compare packed size using the decryption filter's on-disk input count,
  including encryption header and authentication footer. The decompressor's
  input count excludes these bytes and previously skipped the CRC branch for
  encrypted AE-1 and ZipCrypto entries.
- Preserve prior close/authentication failures when reading descriptors.

Reproduction: an intact AES ZIP passes; changing only one authentication
footer byte was accepted by the unmodified bundled ZIP reader, while the
independent 7-Zip ZIP handler refused it. The change applies to integrity
testing, extraction, drag, update preflight and post-write verification.
Raw encrypted copying without a password still uses a raw filter; the
source is authenticated by One's update preflight before copying.

Original copyright and zlib license are retained in LICENSE and source.
This is an altered version; it is not an unmodified upstream release.

mz_zip_rw.c, mz_zip_writer_add_file:
- Store known zero-length filesystem files when XZ compression is selected.
  Their XZ stream was accepted by the bundled reader but rejected by 7-Zip
  25.01/26.04 as trailing payload data. Nonempty files retain XZ compression;
  encryption, filenames, timestamps and attributes are preserved. This also
  covers One's parallel ZIP creation, which uses the same file-entry API.
